profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Principal Engineer | Low-Latency Video Systems | Ethernet Switching & Data Center Networking | 10G Storage Architectures | Distributed Systems | AI/ML & Agentic AI

Engineering leader with 14+ years of experience building carrier-grade Ethernet switching platforms, ultra-low-latency video systems, and high-throughput storage architectures.

My core expertise lies in designing deterministic, high-performance systems at the intersection of networking, embedded platforms or server platforms, and distributed computing.

I have architected systems requiring:

• Multicast A/V distribution over Marvell-based switching platforms and 1 frame video latency using JPEG 2000 ASIC.
• 150ms latency H.264/H.265 streaming using hardware-based encoders/decoders.
• 10G Ethernet and Fibre Channel multi-threaded storage processing.
• Inline deduplication and high-throughput replication systems
• Deterministic 50ms failover (G.8031, Ethernet OAM, Link Aggregation)
• IPv6 routing enhancements and distributed protocol synchronization

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the architecture and development of high-performance video streaming solutions for enterprise and residential AV systems.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including hardware and networking, to ensure seamless video experiences.  
• Specialized in real-time video technologies, focusing on low latency and exceptional quality across Crestron’s platforms.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description: Leading Digital Media Streaming Team for Video/Audio Streaming and conferencing solutions.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Distributed Network Architecture platform for Audio devices for control and redundancy.
IoT SDK Development

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected 10G Ethernet & Fibre Channel storage processing engine
• Designed multi-threaded SCSI command pipeline in Linux user space
• Built high-throughput inline deduplication system
• Developed sync/async replication reducing transfer time by 8x
• Optimized system for high I/O workloads (interrupt storms, memory thrashing, I/O wait)
• Integrated RAID controllers & high-performance caching mechanisms

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented carrier-grade VLAN, QoS, Link Aggregation
• Designed 50ms failover mechanisms (G.8031)
• Implemented Ethernet OAM (IEEE 802.1ag / ITU-T Y.1731)
• Built distributed protocol synchronization modules
• Fixed RTOS performance bottlenecks

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Guided students on system programming, inter process communication, job control, threading, TCP/IP in UNIX.
•	Prepared, distributed and evaluated quizzes and exams.

positions.title: Lab Administrator
positions.description:
•	Resolved software and hardware problems and issues with installed software in NetBSD.
•	Guided students in features of UNIX and NetBSD.
•	Resolved networking issues associated with NetBSD workstations.
